_comment: Pinebook Pro: grow RWFW (partition 11) to 16 MiB. The Rockchip boot ROM loads the boot loader from sector 64, and u-boot-rockchip.bin is about 9 MiB, so it has to sit inside a partition nothing else uses. RWFW comes first in the common ChromiumOS layout and holds no data on this board. install-u-boot.sh checks the actual image before writing and refuses if any other partition overlaps.
